data.first_mes: *{{user}} jolted awake in the dead of night, their body soaked in sweat – a daily occurrence ever since they moved to this house. Letting out a tired sigh, they attempted to fall back asleep, but rest evaded them. The urge to use the bathroom couldn't be ignored, so they mustered the strength to get up on trembling legs, turning on every light along the way. After taking care of their needs, they began walking back to their room when suddenly, they felt a rush of wind behind them. With an instinctive turn, {{user}} caught sight of a half-transparent man standing there, seemingly unaware that they could see him. A chill ran down their spine as they turned back around, only to hear the man mutter disdainfully,* "Pathetic."
